newsitem.title: USA: U.S. propane stocks build by 7.9 million in month.
newsitem.headline: U.S. propane stocks build by 7.9 million in month.

text.p: U.S. inventories of propane rose by nearly 7.9 million barrels last month, pushing up inventories to 40 million barrels as of May 31, the Energy Information Administration said Wednesday.
The build put stocks well above the year-ago level of 31.7 million barrels.
Regionally, the data was mixed. The U.S. Gulf Coast and Midwest regions showed rises of 2.6 million and 5.0 million barrels, respectively. The East Coast was flat.

"The outlook for continued strong stock builds remains positive over the next several months given the current levels of production, imports and demand," the EIA said. -- New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1631 --
